creator: Alexander Terp
description:
main.swift stands up one of everything and says so in its own header.
This is where it stops: a surface, a chrome and a bridge per leaf of
the tree, created and destroyed as the tree changes, with focus
following the view-local cursor rather than the daemon's.

Lay children out from the tree's ratios rather than reaching for
NSSplitView. NSSplitView owns its divider positions, which is a fight
with view = f(daemon state) on every event; a container computing
frames from ratios is small, and a divider drag becomes an intent
rather than local state that then disagrees with the daemon.

The window title also stops carrying agent state once every pane has
its own border. It keeps health, which is per-window.

This is the landing where 15 panes becomes a thing that can be
measured, so a_26JhGElAo closes behind it.
title: 🪟 The shell renders splits, and a drag is an intent
